name: Spectral Material Film
description: Spectral Material Film: original frame-deterministic SVG scene. Source implementation; rendered review pending.
descriptionZh: 暖白空间里的同一橙色轮廓，连续经历平涂、纸面与线版材质。已接入主题选择与默认示例；实际画面、连续动效、字体与 Alpha 边缘待渲染复核。

designIntent.identity: 暖白空间里的同一橙色轮廓与连续材质转换
designIntent.contentLayout: 原创折带形体与留白排版构成主景，材质变化始终绑定同一轮廓
designIntent.semanticMotion: 平涂保持、纸面扫入、线版扫入，最后保留印刷质感
designIntent.distinction: 独立完整 SVG 场景，不复用旧 56 个主题的标题/卡片构图。

fontPolicy.risk: Installed fonts, CJK fallback, real weight faces, line breaks and glyph shapes must be inspected on the actual render machine; these stacks do not promise pixel identity.

tokenRoles.text: Essential titles/body; check actual size/weight and background.
tokenRoles.text-mute: Essential small labels; source flat-surface target >=4.5.
tokenRoles.text-faint: Nonessential low-priority annotation or large labels only; not essential small copy; source flat-surface target >=3.
tokenRoles.accent: Brand fill, nonessential line or large graphic; not assumed safe for small text.
tokenRoles.accent-strong: Small accent-colored text on surface tiers; source target >=4.5.
tokenRoles.accent-on: Text on solid accent fill only; source target >=4.5.
tokenRoles.status: Use labels/icons as well as color; colors do not validate the truth of data.
tokenRoles.chart: Always label directly or use shape/dash as well; pairwise category distinctness remains render-review-pending.

review.notes: Static token contrast checks cover surrounding flat stage/UI roles only; authored SVG palettes, gradients, texture, motion and output pixels require rendered inspection.

materialRisk: 程序化 SVG 平涂、纸面、线条网点近似；不是光线追踪、真实折射、纸张物理或产品实物认证。

runtime.palettePolicy: authored-scene-palette; CSS tokens cover surrounding stage/UI only, not universal SVG recoloring
runtime.timing: frame-deterministic; scene-bound narration and three-step shot plan

limitations: 程序化 SVG 平涂、纸面、线条网点近似；不是光线追踪、真实折射、纸张物理或产品实物认证。
SVG 内部为作者设定配色；编辑 tokens.css 不保证重着色所有主体、渐变或文字。
源代码与类型/静态测试不是视觉验收；实际横竖屏、字幕、字体、连续帧与透明合成仍需检查。
